args.description: a sprite sheet of 16 different dungeon monsters in a 4 by 4 grid, one monster centred in each square cell, no borders, same chunky dark-fantasy pixel art style for all, thick dark outline, rich colours, glowing eyes, three-quarter view. Row by row: a purple cave bat with red eyes; a green slime blob with angry eyes; a skeleton archer with a bow; a hooded red cultist with a dagger; a small red flying imp with horns; an armoured knight with a sword and shield; a pale floating ghost; a flying book monster with teeth; a drowned blue-green zombie with seaweed; a blue fire wisp; a heavy stone golem; a swamp bog creature; a tiny buzzing gnat insect; a swamp witch with a crooked staff; a longbow archer in a green hood; a lancer with a long spear
